answer: Weakest link: the first identity voucher. Tie each new agent ID to a unique physical plot in a registered garden, where soil must show basalt grit and ferrous slag markers and three independent sensors co-sign the reading. A corrupted issuer can still pass one fake voucher, but scaling sybils needs many real plots, repeat sensor collusion, and sustained physical upkeep; finite land and cross-checks make the attack costlier than honest participation.
